{{Quote|But you know what I always say: Speak softly and drive a big tank.|Hondo Ohnaka, on the WLO-5 speeder tank|<ref name="Bounty Hunters">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''WLO-5 speeder tank''', also known as the '''Ubrikkian tank''', '''pirate repulsortank''', or simply '''pirate tank''', was a model of [[heavy repulsortank]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Ord Pedrova/Legends|Ubrikkian Ord Pedrova]]. Equipped with heavy armor and weaponry, it was used by a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] operating out of the backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].

==Description==
[[File:WLO-5_speeder_tank.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A WLO-5 tank being refueled.]]
The WLO-5 [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]] was flanked on each side with one large [[Turbine/Legends|turbine]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]].<ref name="GAW" /> It was armed with a single turret-mounted [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] [[MS-1 fire-linked heavy laser cannon/Legends|MS-1 fire-linked heavy laser cannon]],<ref name="The Gungan General Episode Guide" /> which could turn 360 degrees and was located on the top of the tank.<ref name="GAW" /> The tank was also armed with a pair of anti-personnel [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] located on the bow.<ref name="SWE entry" /> The turret [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] sat in the open, behind the [[Heavy laser cannon/Legends|heavy laser cannon]], protected only by the gun's side-armor.<ref name="TGG" /> Two additional crewmen [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the craft from inside the vehicle, protected by its [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The additional crew had access to [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-based targeting software.<ref name="GAW" />

The craft could also function as a [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]], with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] capable of jumping out from the middle section of the tank.<ref name="The Gungan General Episode Guide" /> It was favored by pirates because of its ease of use, repair, and modification. [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] was known to operate several of these vehicles in his "[[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|empire]]."<ref name="GAW" /> They were considered to be an operational equivalent to the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with the tanks being more maneuverable but less powerful.<ref name="SWE entry" />

==History==
{{Quote|Kill him! Kill him! He's no representative! He's a plague!|A [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] tank gunner after Jar Jar drove his tank against another tank|audio=HesAPlague-TheGunganGeneral.flac|<ref name="TGG" />}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:Hondo_tank.png|thumb|220px|Hondo Ohnaka standing on a WLO-5 tank on Felucia.]]</div>
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Time">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places events prior to the episode in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> amidst the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of Hondo Ohnaka, wanted to steal the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|sent]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in exchange for the captive [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. His plans to steal the spice failed and to cover up his deceit he told Ohnaka that the Republic hadn't send the ransom, but an army instead. Falso convinced Ohnaka to send tanks to destroy the army.<ref name="TGG" />

These tanks were called "Bombad clankens" by Republic [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], upon seeing them. During the rescue of Ohnaka's captive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from Ohnaka's pirate gang, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] Binks was captured by pirates in the tanks. When he walked onto one of the tanks, Binks' clumsiness caused him to slip and cause the tank to hit the tank next to it. The tank then veered into the power line to Ohnaka's base, causing the electricity in the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate base]] to go out. The Jedi were freed from their [[Torture/Legends|torture]] device, but Dooku escaped his cell and he left [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in a stolen [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|Flarestar attack shuttle]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and Binks then approached the pirate compound, hidden from view inside two stolen tanks and together with the Jedi, they left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].<ref name="TGG" />

[[File:WLO-5_speeder_tanks.png|thumb|left|200px|Two of Hondo Ohnaka's speeder tanks]]
Ohnaka would later use one of the tanks carried aboard a [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class frigate]] to [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|raid]] a [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] [[Akira/Legends|farm]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. The raid was not a success, as Jedi and a team of bounty hunters fought off the Ohnaka gang.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Maul">''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence]]'' places the [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] revival arc in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> one of Ohnaka's speeder tanks was stolen by escaping Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]].<ref name="TCW:BFR">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref> Their craft was pursued by another of the tanks. The pursuing tank shot out one of the engines on the Jedis' tank, but the pirate craft was knocked aside by the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], piloted by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The pirates captured the Jedi, though, and returned to the outpost. The outpost had been captured by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], and Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] convinced her captors to help them. R2-D2 drove the tank past the droid forces, and the Jedi rescued Ohnaka. Together they boarded R2's tank, but were pursued by Grievous himself in a [[Combat speeder/Legends|combat speeder]]. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General boarded the top of the tank and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] Tano. R2-D2 tried to maneuver the tank to force Grievous off, but it was wrecked in the resulting crash. The Jedi were then rescued by Ohnaka in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] and returned to the Republic.<ref name="TCW:ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The WLO-5 speeder tanks first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode ''[[The Gungan General]]'' and received their identification in the sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''.

[[The LEGO Group]] has created a set of the tank featuring [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The set was released August 1, 2009.<ref name="TnPTcbLEGO">{{SWArchive|url=vault/collecting/20090421.html|text=LEGO® Clone Wars Pirate Tank a Target Exclusive}}</ref>
